center:
Getting AI to do recurring work
in your tools, unattended
strength_rule: H = 100+ reactions, 200+ HN points, or a dominant review theme across 100+ reviews. M = 20-99 reactions or 3-9 threads. L = one thread or under 20 reactions. W = only found secondhand.

pains.text: Workflows fail silently: no error, no log (forum + 2 Reddit threads: 'silently stopped')
OAuth tokens die, reconnect by hand
AI Agent node loops, claims it did things
Credentials don't travel on client handover
Task burn and billing traps (1.3/5, 323 reviews)
AI builder promises what it can't do
Agents runs missed on stale sign-ins

No browser: can't check the UI

silent.name: It fails silently, or says done when it isn't
silent.how:
A separate reviewer checks every run against your must-pass lines and sends the gap back; after 3 tries it brings you the work and what still falls short. A finished or failed scheduled run is pushed to your chat. A watchdog means no run hangs forever.
judge-deliverables.ts:24 · re-brief-agent.ts:423 · chat-run-stream-do.ts:58 · chat-run-do-lifecycle.ts:114

cost.name: It burns budget or hits limits mid-run
cost.how:
Runs on the Claude or Codex plan you already pay for, with a usage bar per window. At the limit tasks wait, then continue, and never switch to paid credits on their own. It does not make your plan's limits bigger.
cli-account-pool-do.ts:14 · plan-usage.ts:76

auth.name: Connections and sign-ins expire
auth.how:
Tokens refresh before they expire. One run per plan account at a time, so parallel runs never break the refresh. A reconnect lands as a card in Approvals.
oauth/token-refresh.ts · cli-account-pool-do.ts:9

browser.name: It can't sign in, has no browser, gets stuck at a CAPTCHA
browser.how:
Every agent has a real browser. A sign-in or CAPTCHA opens a live browser you clear once, and it carries on from the same page. Its own inbox reads the codes.
browser-tools.ts:283 · browser-takeover.ts · mail-router

setup.name: Environment setup, secrets, self-hosting
setup.how:
Nothing to host. Each agent gets a ready computer with a browser; credentials stay server-side. A complex repo can still need setup.
_sandbox.ts:70 · container-secrets.ts

scope.name: Tied to GitHub, can't work outside the repo
scope.how:
Any service with an MCP server, a key or a sign-in page; posts to Lark, Slack, Telegram.
mcp-connect.ts · send-im-message.ts:17

babysit.name: It needs babysitting, or asks about every step
babysit.how:
Choose assistive, supervised or autonomous. Only risky steps wait, all in one Approvals inbox; a comment wakes the agent with your note.
autonomy.ts:80 · human-actions/service.ts:67

team.name: It isn't shared with the team
team.how:
Workflows, files and connections belong to the workspace; one calendar for every agent.
r2-direct-adapter.ts:94

handover.name: Versioning and handing over to clients
handover.how:
Workflow versions and history; the client connects their own accounts through Approvals. No git branching.
workflow-versions.ts · approvals/connect-account.ts

memory.name: It forgets or loses work between runs
memory.how:
One shared file tree persists; a new message continues the right earlier chat by meaning.
r2-direct-adapter.ts:94 · related-work.ts
